## Failed Tests — Detail

### ❌ Business Policy Lumpsum Specific Injury Cover (ACB-2941) › AC13: with business Specific Injury + MLC (Mortgage & Living) active, the MLC Specific Injury Support Benefit is greyed out

**Acceptance Criteria (from user story):**

> AC13: Given Specific Injury selected for a business policy, When I select MLC (Mortgage & Living) cover for the same life insured on any personal policy, Then the "Specific Injury Support Benefit" option UNDER the MLC cover is greyed out and cannot be selected.
> 
> Steps to reproduce:
> 1. New quote, ANB 40, Employed, Income $150,000 (MLC needs employment/income) — on the Personal policy.
> 2. Activate Mortgage & Living (personal). 3. Switch to Business, Life companion $200k, activate Specific Injury (SI $1,000).
> 4. Locate the "Specific Injury Support Benefit" control under the personal MLC cover; check disabled.
> 
> Expected: the MLC Specific Injury Support Benefit control is disabled/greyed once a business Specific Injury exists.

**What was compared:**

| Check | Expected | Actual |

| MLC "Specific Injury Support Benefit" control state (AC13) | found & disabled (greyed) | {"found":true,"hasCheckbox":true,"nativeDisabled":false,"aria":null,"disabled":false} |

**Assertion failure:**
